items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I was involved with a psychiatric social worker -- her name was Iris... I married Iris in 1970.

ctx.x: But for a musician, it's very important, very monumental -- that first car, especially for a rhythm section man, a drummer, that's one of the reasons I really wanted to ask that question. But there's a lot of things in the fifties here which I wanted to parallel with your family, and where did you go from there when you and Helen split up? What did you do then with your life?

Well, I tell you -- my life was awfully rough. I was involved -- I was fortunate enough that I was involved with a psychiatric social worker -- her name was Iris, and her brother was a great jazz Dixieland jazz fan, band-player, back then.
So I was working on the weekend at the Central Plaza, which was a place where all the musicians used to work on Friday and Saturday.
